_comment: Pharmacy directory seed. 50 rows, all from the Hamdard Laboratories (Waqf) Bangladesh official website (head office + 49 branch centres read 2026-10-11). Unverified: no row is_verified, none confirmed — an admin must check and mark them. Pins come from the Google Maps links Hamdard publishes. No homeopathy/ayurveda rows: no source meeting this bar was found.
